versions.changelog:
Version 1.7.0 adds detailed rule updates, enhanced exception classification, and compensation cap rules:

- Added AE-03 detailed sub-rules for trajectory exceptions (returns, misdelivery, disorder).
- Introduced AE-10 supplier joint rating rules and improved incident handling.
- Clarified maximum compensation (赔偿封顶) rules, ensuring consistent application.
- Standardized references to GLOSSARY.md, INSUFFICIENCY-HANDLING.md, and RULE-UPDATE-SOP.md.
- Updated exception type definitions and boundary logic for improved precision.
- Expanded workflows and report templates for both single and batch logistics alerts.
